title: Health & pharmacy
body:
Emergency numbers: police 110, ambulance/fire 119 — both free and nationwide. ⚠ English on either line is not something to count on in Obanazawa or Yamadera; where you can, have the ryokan or hotel front desk place the call.

Yamagata city has the usual national drugstore chains (Matsumoto Kiyoshi, Cocokara Fine, Sun Drug) for over-the-counter needs; English support is basic, not fluent medical consultation. Ginzan Onsen and Yamadera have no pharmacy — bring what the group needs for those days.

⚠ Routine vaccinations, MMR included, should be current before departure — check your own doctor or national health authority for Japan's current recommendations.
